subject: POC: Stakeholder wiring, success criteria & owners (next steps)
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ramos <elena@tradelane.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: POC: Stakeholder wiring, success criteria & owners (next steps)

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick written recap so we have alignment before I share the onboarding checklist: this note captures proposed success criteria, evaluation plan, timeline, and who should own what on both sides. If anything looks off, flag it and I’ll iterate.

High-level ask from Tradelane: validate Redwood can reduce inference cost and latency for your shipment-tracking reranking use case while preserving accuracy on your N-best ranking.

Proposed POC scope (4 weeks):
- Target flow: shipment event to ranked notification candidates via Redwood API (server-to-server).
- Dataset: 3k recent events + 200 hand-labeled re-ranks for accuracy checks.
- Benchmarks: 95% of baseline NDCG; tail latency P95 < 150 ms; cost per 1k tokens <= $X (to be confirmed).

Acceptance criteria (final):
- Functional: model outputs match business rules and augment recall for edge cases.
- Performance: average latency and throughput meet targets above.
- Ops: secure VPC peering or short-lived API key flow; audit logs available for sample window.

Owners (proposed RACI-style callouts):
- Customer infra (R): Tradelane IT (Priya B.) — VPC connectivity / firewall rules.
- Customer app (A): Elena (Product) — test datasets, business validation.
- Redwood infra (R): Marcus Lin — private onboarding, region placement.
- Redwood integration (A): Karthik Iyer — API keys, sample scripts, batching config.
- Security/compliance (C): Security teams on both sides (we’ll schedule a short review).
- Procurement (I): Tradelane procurement contact (cc’d Priya when engaged).

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) I’ll send the onboarding checklist + short infra RACI CSV (attached).
2) Karthik to run a brief infra/security pre-check (firewall, TLS, KMS) — target this week.
3) Elena to share sample event schema + 1st batch (anonymized) by Thu 6/17.
4) Kickoff call: Thu 6/18, 10:00 AM PT — confirm attendees (Marcus, Priya, you, Karthik, me).

Attachments: Tradelane_POC_Checklist.pdf (checklist), Infrastructure_RACI.csv (owner matrix)

Thanks — keen to get this moving.

— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0134
From: Elena Ramos <elena@tradelane.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Bhatia <priya.bhatia@tradelane.com>, Tradelane IT <it@tradelane.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 17:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC: Stakeholder wiring, success criteria & owners (next steps)

Thanks Stephanie — helpful recap. A couple clarifications:

1) Acceptance: our internal bar for NDCG is a bit tighter — can we target 97% of baseline as the goal, with a rollback trigger at 94%?
2) Latency: P95 < 150 ms sounds good for hosted flows. For VPC/private we may accept up to 200 ms during initial tuning.
3) Data: I can share anonymized events but procurement needs a one-page data transfer note for the pilot. Priya is cc’d to help.

Priya — can your team confirm: who owns opening ports for the rewrite environment (we use an internal whitelist process)? Also, can you confirm an internal security reviewer available next Tues?

I’m good for the kickoff on Thu 6/18 10am PT — Marcus and Karthik on the invite is ideal.

On the RACI — small ask: can Redwood own the integration adapter (A) and be consulted on app-level rule edge cases? That will make the run faster.

Best,
Elena
Product Lead, Tradelane Logistics
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ramos <elena@tradelane.com>, Priya Bhatia <priya.bhatia@tradelane.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC: Stakeholder wiring, success criteria & owners (next steps)

Thanks — quick operational checklist from my side (so engineering knows scope before kickoff):

Infra/security pre-check (owner: Redwood - Karthik & Marcus):
- Confirm egress rules and IP ranges for short-lived API keys (action: Marcus)
- Validate TLS + mTLS options; default to TLS for initial pilot, mTLS if required (action: Karthik)
- KMS: if Tradelane wants customer-managed keys, we’ll need the key ARN and policy pre-setup (action: Priya/Tradelane)

Data flow and onboarding (owner: Tradelane - Elena):
- Provide sample schema + 1k anonymized events by 2026-06-17 (action: Elena)
- Provide a small evaluation label set (200 rows) for accuracy checks (action: Elena)

Integration & runbook (owner: Redwood):
- Provide sample ingestion script, batching config, and a Docker integration example (deliverable: integration.zip)
- Provide a short troubleshooting playbook (deliverable: POC-runbook.md)

Procurement (owner: Tradelane procurement):
- Signed pilot MSA addendum or PO to allow data exchange and short-term credits — target week of 6/21

Notes:
- If Tradelane requires VPC peering rather than host API keys, lead time may add 1–2 weeks. Recommend API-for-pilot to hit the 4-week target.

I’ll block time Wed 6/16 11:00 AM PT for a 30-min infra sync with Priya and Marcus to walk the pre-check list.

— Karthik
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ramos <elena@tradelane.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Priya Bhatia <priya@tradelane.com>

Subject: Re: POC: Stakeholder wiring, success criteria & owners (next steps)

Perfect — thanks everyone. Confirming next steps and owners (short list):

- Elena: sample events + 200 labeled rows by Thu 6/17 (owner: Elena)
- Priya: confirm firewall/whitelist owner + availability for Wed 6/16 11:00 AM PT infra sync (owner: Priya)
- Marcus: prepare integration host + IP ranges (owner: Marcus)
- Karthik: share integration.zip + POC-runbook.md by EOD Wed 6/16 (owner: Karthik)
- Stephanie: send calendar invite for Thu 6/18 10:00 AM PT kickoff + upload checklist and RACI to Drive (owner: Stephanie)

I’ve attached the onboarding checklist and the RACI CSV for quick reference. If Tradelane prefers a different owner mapping, flag it on the sheet and we’ll adjust quickly.

Calendar invite and Drive folder link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bPOCdocs
